generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: an evergreen woody vine that climbs by clinging roots up trunks into the crowns of trees, with glossy, dark, three- to five-lobed leaves on climbing shoots and flowering, black-berried shoots where it reaches the light; introduced and invasive in the forests of the Pacific Northwest, where it smothers bigleaf maples. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough heights from general knowledge of the species: about 6 m up its host at 8 years and 12 m at 15. Wide tolerances.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye from photographs: dark glossy green leaves, black berries.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

host.note: The host the spec's authors chose for this guest, grown at the age, environment and seed given.
